# WhatsClean 1.0.2
## What’s new since 1.0
- Replaced repeated macOS app-data prompts with guided, persistent WhatsApp folder access. - Restricted scanning to the official WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business media folder, preventing files from other apps from appearing. - Improved responsive window resizing so text and controls remain visible at smaller sizes. - Added a dedicated in-app Settings button and window. - Added System, Light, and Dark appearance options. - Added visible refresh progress and a last-updated timestamp. - Standardized the application interface and distribution documentation in English. - Refined the icon for the native macOS Tahoe rounded mask without the extra white legacy tile. - Added a modern asset catalog for Tahoe plus a complete legacy ICNS fallback for macOS 12–15. - Embedded icon representations from 16×16 through 1024×1024 for Finder, Dock, Quick Look, and Launchpad. - Enlarged and centered the green phone symbol for better readability at every icon size.

# WhatsClean 1.0.1
- Replaced repeated macOS app-data prompts with guided folder access. - Automatically opens the expected WhatsApp data location. - Remembers the selected folder across app launches. - Added a Change Folder option in Settings. - Added System, Light, and Dark appearance options. - Added an in-app Settings button and a dedicated settings window. - Added visible refresh progress and a last-updated timestamp. - Standardized the application interface language to English.

# WhatsClean 1.0.0
- Native Apple Silicon application. - Automatic updates powered by Sparkle.
